title: Fun way to explore Seville
text: Our guide was excellent. Knowledgeable and friendly. The tour, via segway, enabled us to see and explore places and monuments we would not of visited if walking, due to the distances we travelled. A fun way to see Seville. We highly recommend this business.
author: X6207RCelizabethd

title: What a wonderful and fun experience.
text: Four of us went on this tour with our guide Pierre. He was knowledgeable, and we learned unique things about all of the sights we visited.  Riding the Segways was a blast. We were able to ride along the river, through the parks, and get close up to the historical sights. It was so much more than we could have ever seen on foot. A definite "must do".
author: Q2522JKmichelem

title: Great experience
text: We had Milena as our Segway guide, she was amazing and really detailed with her history of Seville. Milena also took loads of pics for us. Would highly recommend if visiting Seville!
author: P8395JVdavidt

title: Fantastic tour with Emilio
text: We were big fans of Emilio , he was a very friendly and hugely informed tour guide. He was very knowledgeable and took us on a comprehensive tour of the city . He was a good instructor and showed us how to use the Segway in a calm manner and made sure the tour went smoothly. He was generous with his time and we thoroughly enjoyed our tour with him. Thank you Emilio , highly recommended.
author: Passport57946683001

title: Fun, safe and beautiful tour🇪🇸😊
text: Excellent tour. Plenty of history and sights. Our guide, Milena was very friendly, thoughtful and  knowledgable. Great opportunity to visit many beautiful landmarks of Sevilla.
author: Alley2014

title: Great Segway Tour!
text: Milena gave us a wonderful tour. The Segway’s kept it enjoyable enough for my 13 year old son and allowed me to get a great overview of the history of the city. Milena was very engaging and knowledgeable. Thank you!
author: daviescarrfamily

title: Fantastic Segway tour
text: Would highly recommend a tour with Emilio! He is a fantastic guide, extremely knowledgeable about his city, interesting & very likeable. An asset to Jetwalk. We learned so much about Seville - thank you Emilio!
author: Adventure21714144302

title: Brilliant
text: One of our favourite city Segway tours - Emilio was awesome - super friendly and informative - we had so much fun and would hugely recommend
author: 16louisew

title: Segway delight
text: This was so much fun!  My first time on a segway, but was completely confident after our guide, Emilio, showed us how to use the segway safely. He was full of insights and historical perspectives. And very entertaining! I highly recommend this guided segway tour. Raj
author: Raj_V

title: The best way to see Sevilla! 🏆
text:
Emilio, our guide, was fantastic! He was both knowledgeable about the city and incredibly entertaining. The tour was a great way to see Sevilla and learn about its history and culture. We loved the Segways and had a blast exploring the city on them.

The tour started a bit late due to a previous tour not returning their Segways on time, but this actually worked out well for us. It gave our kids (aged 10, 13, and 16) more time to practice riding the Segways and get comfortable with them.
